production-function-tp-mp.alt: Two graphs for a bakery with one oven. Total product rises from 10 to 48 loaves as workers go from 1 to 5 and stays at 48 for 6 workers. Marginal product is 10, 14, 12, 8, 4, 0 loaves: it rises for the first two workers, then falls, which is diminishing marginal returns; average product is drawn dashed.
